description: This Java class defines the 'CleanupPersistence' command used in a persistence cleanup process within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages initiating cleanup operations for specific entities by their EntityId, supports JSON serialization/deserialization, and adheres to the command pattern.

classes.name: CleanupPersistence
classes.description: Immutable command class to initiate cleanup of persistence for an entity identified by EntityId, capable of JSON serialization/deserialization and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CleanupPersistence command for a specific entity ID with given headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the EntityId associated with this cleanup command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new CleanupPersistence instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a CleanupPersistence command from a JSON object and headers.
